questions.solution_text:
Rest starts at $2{:}30$ pm.
$2{:}30+45\text{ min}=3{:}15$ pm
The distance reading does not change during the rest, so the segment from $2{:}30$ pm to $3{:}15$ pm is horizontal.

questions.solution_text:
Leaves the park at $8{:}40+20\text{ min}=9{:}00$ am
The return is at the same speed, so it also takes $40$ minutes.
$9{:}00+40\text{ min}=9{:}40$ am
